clause: You may cancel anytime from Settings, then Billing, then Cancel, effective at the end of your billing period.

strict.reason: The clause simply allows the user to cancel at any time, with no hidden fees or penalties.

generous.reason: The clause merely allows cancellation without any cost or restriction.

adjudicator.plain: The clause allows the reader to cancel their subscription at any time by navigating to Settings → Billing → Cancel, with the cancellation taking effect at the end of the current billing period.
adjudicator.action: If you wish to cancel, go to Settings → Billing → Cancel.
